card.name: The word non before hyphenated terms
card.fires_on: The word "non" right before a hyphen in sterile-supply and preparation text, as in non-pyrogenic, non-fenestrated, non-adhesive or non-bacteriostatic.

modes.label: non- before supply descriptors
modes.description: "non" starts a hyphenated property of sterile items, supplies or drapes.
modes.example: the list of standard surgical supplies needed for ZEVASKYN administration and not provided by the manufacturer: scalpel scissors forceps resorbable sutures<< non>>-adhesive dressings topical antibiotic oint

modes.label: non- in filter or diluent descriptions
modes.description: "non" begins a property of an IV line, diluent or product, such as pyrogenic, bacteriostatic or replicating.
